Yes, [Edgepark Medical Supplies](https://www.edgepark.com/) is a large, national Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and direct-to-home medical supply provider. They specialize in shipping prescription medical products directly to patients' homes and handling the associated insurance billing. [](https://www.medica.com/find-care/national-durable-medical-equipment-suppliers)

- **Diabetes supplies:** Insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), and testing strips

- **Ostomy and urological care:** Pouches, barriers, catheters, and related accessories

- **Wound care and incontinence:** Specialized dressings, briefs, and skincare items [](https://www.edgeparkhealth.com/hcp)

### Core Services

- **Insurance processing:** Verifying benefits and filing claims with Medicare, Medicaid, and private insurance plans

- **Prescription coordination:** Working directly with doctors to collect required medical documentation

- **Home delivery:** Managing scheduled shipments and reorders [](https://www.edgepark.com/)
